hypothesis: ensureInventoryLevels validates each entry of a reservation batch against the same un-decremented available_quantity, so two entries for WIDGET at the same location each pass while their sum exceeds the stock of 10. A single cart with two lines sharing WIDGET (OVS-PIECE x6 plus OVS-TWOPACK x3 = 12 WIDGET units) goes through complete-cart as one createReservationItems batch, so the order should be placed with 12 units reserved against 10 stocked. I expect no_oversell to fail (live reservations exceed stock and order demand exceeds stocked units), and reserved_matches_reservations should still hold because the counter sums the same entries.
